title: Fractions, Decimals and Percentages (KS2)
subject: Maths
strapline: Three ways to show the same part of a whole.
facts: A fraction shows parts of a whole: in 3/4 the denominator (4) is the number of equal parts, the numerator (3) is how many you have.
Equivalent fractions are equal in value: 1/2 = 2/4 = 5/10.
A decimal uses place value after a decimal point: 0.5 means five tenths.
A percentage is a fraction out of 100: 25% means 25 out of 100.
To find a fraction of an amount, divide by the denominator then multiply by the numerator.
To simplify a fraction, divide the top and bottom by the same number.
teacher_tips: Use a fraction wall so equivalence is a picture, not a rule.
Keep switching between the three forms so links become automatic.
Divide-then-multiply for "fraction of amount" — model it every time.
